messages.subject: Extract R files from shinyapp application
parts:
This is a somewhat odd question. Basically I developed an application, uploaded it to my shinyapps.io account, and then suffered a crash and lost the local version of the application? Is there any way to download the R scripts from my shinyapps.io account?

Now to go invest in better version control practices....

Thanks, 

-Gordon
